name: ocapi
description: Manage an Ocapi online store: products, categories, orders and images.

interface.longDescription:
Ocapi lets small businesses run an online store and take orders through WhatsApp and online payments. This app lets ChatGPT manage that store for you, with your own Ocapi account.

What you can ask ChatGPT to do:
- Catalog: list, create, update, hide, reorder and delete products, including prices, sale prices, inventory, variants, deals and add-ons.
- Categories: create, rename, hide, reorder and delete them.
- Orders: find orders by payment or fulfilment status, see their items and customer details, move them along (for example to shipped), and record orders you took by phone or chat.
- Store profile: update your store's name, description, phone, logo and cover.
- Images: import a public image link, including Google Drive links, and use it on products, logos or covers.

New to Ocapi? Sign in with any email or Google account and ChatGPT can set up your store.

Changes go live on your storefront right away. ChatGPT asks before deleting anything, and hiding a product is a reversible alternative. You sign in with your Ocapi account and approve the connection on Ocapi's consent page, and you can disconnect it anytime under Settings → Connected apps and AI.
defaultPrompt: Use Ocapi to list my products and their prices.
Use Ocapi to show my unpaid orders.
Use Ocapi to set up my online store.

positive.expected_behavior: Shows one store, Review Demo Coffee, with its currency (USD) and storefront URL.

positive.description: Lists the store's products with their prices.
positive.prompt: What products do I have in my Ocapi store?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the store's products with their prices, including House blend, 250 g ($14) and Logo mug ($16).

positive.prompt: Put the Logo mug on sale for $12 in my Ocapi store.
positive.expected_behavior: Sets the Logo mug's sale price to 12 and confirms the change; the regular price stays $16.

positive.description: Finds orders that are still unpaid.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Ben Ortiz's pending order with its items (Pour-over dripper and Paper filters) and its $31 total.

positive.description: Records an order taken over chat, with its payment.
positive.prompt: Record a paid order in my Ocapi store for Carla Ruiz: two Colombian single origin bags.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a paid order for Carla Ruiz with two Colombian single origin, 250 g bags and confirms it with a $36 total.

negative.description: A creative request unrelated to running a store should not call Ocapi.
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about coffee.

negative.description: A general finance question should not call Ocapi.
negative.prompt: What's the exchange rate from Colombian pesos to US dollars today?

negative.description: Looking for a place to buy coffee is not about the merchant's own store and should not call Ocapi.
negative.prompt: Recommend a good coffee shop in Austin.

publication.release_notes: First release: manage products, categories, orders, images and the store profile, and set up a new store.

es-419.subtitle: Administra tu tienda online
es-419.description:
Ocapi permite a los pequeños negocios tener una tienda online y recibir pedidos por WhatsApp y pagos en línea. Con esta app, ChatGPT administra tu tienda con tu propia cuenta de Ocapi: crea y edita productos, precios, inventario, variantes, promociones y adicionales; organiza categorías; revisa pedidos, actualiza su estado y registra ventas que tomaste por teléfono o chat; actualiza el perfil de tu tienda; e importa imágenes desde un enlace público.

¿Eres nuevo en Ocapi? Inicia sesión con cualquier correo o cuenta de Google y ChatGPT puede crear tu tienda.

Los cambios aparecen en tu tienda de inmediato y ChatGPT te pide confirmación antes de borrar algo. Puedes desconectar la app cuando quieras desde Configuración → Apps e IA conectados.

pt-BR.subtitle: Gerencie sua loja online
pt-BR.description:
A Ocapi permite que pequenos negócios tenham uma loja online e recebam pedidos pelo WhatsApp e pagamentos online. Com este app, o ChatGPT gerencia sua loja com sua própria conta da Ocapi: cria e edita produtos, preços, estoque, variações, promoções e adicionais; organiza categorias; consulta pedidos, atualiza o status e registra vendas feitas por telefone ou chat; atualiza o perfil da loja; e importa imagens de um link público.

Novo na Ocapi? Entre com qualquer e-mail ou conta Google e o ChatGPT pode criar sua loja.

As alterações aparecem na sua loja na hora e o ChatGPT pede confirmação antes de excluir algo. Você pode desconectar o app quando quiser em Configurações → Apps e IA conectadas.
